text: People keep asking me: do you really type a feature request, and then agents just go and build it?
Honestly? Yes. But we didn't buy an AI solution. We compiled our operating processes into code.
Two foundations carry all of it. The ticket holds the state. The team chat is the interface.
Four pillars stand on them. A nervous system, a skill marketplace, autonomous agents. And a cockpit.
A word in the chat wakes an agent. It implements the change, opens a pull request, and reports back.
The same skill runs for a person, an agent, and the CI pipeline. One script, not three.
Nearly every guardrail came from a mistake. Don't trust the model. Verify with code.
Autonomy, with a hand on the brake lever.
